verdict.rationale: An LLM observability platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows external coding agents such as Claude Code connecting through the W&B MCP server and Skills, which is an integration for outside agents, not a built-in assistant. The Playground and LLM-judge scorers are adjacent features for testing prompts and scoring outputs, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
